<style>
.ipcc-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; margin: 1rem 0; border: 1px solid #9aa0a6; }
.ipcc-610 { border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; table-layout: fixed; min-width: 1840px; width: 100%; font-size: .78rem; line-height: 1.1; }
.ipcc-610 th, .ipcc-610 td { border-right: 1px solid #999; border-bottom: 1px solid #999; padding: .3rem .25rem; text-align: center; background-clip: padding-box; }
.ipcc-610 thead th { font-weight: 650; vertical-align: bottom; }
.ipcc-610 .sector, .ipcc-610 .activity { text-align: left; background: white; }
.ipcc-610 .sector { position: sticky; left: 0; z-index: 4; width: 145px; min-width: 145px; }
.ipcc-610 .activity { position: sticky; left: 145px; z-index: 4; width: 150px; min-width: 150px; box-shadow: 2px 0 0 #777; }
.ipcc-610 thead .sector, .ipcc-610 thead .activity { z-index: 6; }
.ipcc-610 .cid { height: 205px; width: 42px; min-width: 42px; padding: .35rem .15rem; writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); white-space: normal; }
.ipcc-610 .super { background: #fff; font-size: .9rem; }
.ipcc-610 .group { font-size: .84rem; }
.ipcc-610 .heat { background: #fbf0d8; } .ipcc-610 .wet { background: #f8e3d8; }
.ipcc-610 .wind { background: #f3dff0; } .ipcc-610 .snow { background: #e8def2; }
.ipcc-610 .coastal { background: #dceff6; } .ipcc-610 .ocean { background: #e5efd9; }
.ipcc-610 .other { background: #e7e7e7; }
.ipcc-610 td.rel { font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 750; color: #202124; }
.ipcc-610 td.p { background: #8fc96f; } .ipcc-610 td.m { background: #ffc25b; }
.ipcc-610 td.n { background: #ed6d55; }
.ipcc-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .45rem 1rem; margin: .6rem 0 0; font-size: .85rem; }
.ipcc-legend + .ipcc-table-caption { margin-top: .15rem; }
.ipcc-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; }
.ipcc-swatch { min-width: 2.1rem; padding: .22rem .45rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 750; border: 1px solid #888; }
.ipcc-swatch.p { background: #8fc96f; } .ipcc-swatch.m { background: #ffc25b; } .ipcc-swatch.n { background: #ed6d55; }
@media (max-width: 700px) { .ipcc-610 { font-size: .72rem; } .ipcc-610 .sector { width: 115px; min-width: 115px; } .ipcc-610 .activity { left: 115px; width: 125px; min-width: 125px; } }
</style>

**Relevance of the key climatic impact drivers (and their respective changes in intensity, frequency, duration, timing, and spatial extent) for major categories of activities in the energy sector.** The climatic impact drivers (CIDs) are identified in Table 12.1 in Chapter 12 of the WGI AR6 report. The symbols indicate whether a change in a climatic impact-driver may have a positive (`+`), negative (`−`), or mixed (`±`) relationship with the corresponding energy activity. D&amp;O: Design and Operation; CF: Capacity Factor. *Adapted from Working Group III Table 6.10 in* @IPCC_2022_WGIII_Ch06.
:::
